reason: This is a broad, cross-cutting introduction of a new vector data type and related functions. It touches parser SQL semantics, expression/type inference and pushdown, planner preprocess/optimizer logic, executor aggregation/runtime paths, table metadata, KV checks, row encoding/decoding, DDL, and server result encoding. New type semantics plus storage/encoding changes have high blast radius and are exactly the kind of change that can hide Blocker/High correctness issues.
